verses.text: Sing to Yahweh a new song! Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.
lines: Sing to Yahweh a new song!
Sing to Yahweh, all the earth.

verses.text: Sing to Yahweh! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
lines: Sing to Yahweh!
Bless his name!
Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

verses.text: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
lines: Declare his glory among the nations,
his marvelous works among all the peoples.

verses.text: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
lines: For Yahweh is great, and greatly to be praised!
He is to be feared above all gods.

verses.text: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but Yahweh made the heavens.
lines: For all the gods of the peoples are idols,
but Yahweh made the heavens.

verses.text: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
lines: Honor and majesty are before him.
Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

verses.text: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.
lines: Ascribe to Yahweh, you families of nations,
ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

verses.text: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
lines: Ascribe to Yahweh the glory due to his name.
Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

verses.text: Worship Yahweh in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
lines: Worship Yahweh in holy array.
Tremble before him, all the earth.

verses.text: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
lines: Say among the nations, “Yahweh reigns.”
The world is also established.
It can’t be moved.
He will judge the peoples with equity.

verses.text: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
lines: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice.
Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

verses.text: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
lines: Let the field and all that is in it exult!
Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

verses.text: before Yahweh; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
lines: before Yahweh; for he comes,
for he comes to judge the earth.
He will judge the world with righteousness,
the peoples with his truth.
